name: List Lambdas for High-Performance Nested Array Transformations
description: Modern analytical warehouses store nested array payloads (e.g. array of discount percentages). Transforming or filtering elements directly inside the array without unnesting and re-aggregating saves massive compute.
prompt:
Modern analytical warehouses store nested array payloads (e.g. array of discount percentages). Transforming or filtering elements directly inside the array without unnesting and re-aggregating saves massive compute.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: cart_id, raw_discounts, qualifying_discounts, doubled_qualifying_discounts.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Filter out discounts <= 5% and double remaining discount percentages using list lambdas
            SELECT 
                cart_id,
                discounts_applied AS raw_discounts,
                list_filter(discounts_applied, lambda x: x > 5) AS qualifying_discounts,
                list_transform(
                    list_filter(discounts_applied, lambda x: x > 5), 
                    lambda x: x * 2
                ) AS doubled_qualifying_discounts
            FROM shopping_carts
            ORDER BY cart_id;
why_it_fails: Unnesting arrays to flat rows and re-aggregating with LIST() triggers expensive hash shuffles.
